shortDescription: V2 THESIS PROVEN in-game: a colonist hauled steel out of a SEALED room joined only by a synthetic RegionLink, zero hauling code. One Map, 3 stacked bands, Building_Door stair portals, movement segmented at Pawn_PathFollower. See-below + real mountain sky now built.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

---

# ✅ V2 THESIS PROVEN — run #7, 2026-07-26

**A colonist hauled 50 steel out of a SEALED stone chamber — no door, no gap — whose only connection to the world was a synthetic `RegionLink`. Zero hauling code, zero WorkGiver patches.**

Validates the whole architecture: `Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial** ⇒ two distant regions sharing a `RegionLink` are adjacent to RimWorld ⇒ `Reachability.CanReach` (managed region-BFS) works unpatched ⇒ **transitively** carries `ClosestThingReachable` → `RegionTraverser` → storage search → **every `WorkGiver_Scanner` in the game**.

**Consequence: hauling, needs, prisoners, mechs, trade, visitors, beds, hunting and combat are DELETED in V2, not reimplemented.** Parity is inherited from vanilla.

---

# ARCHITECTURE V2 — branch `v2-spike`, green 0/0

## Why the pivot (V1 diagnosis)
Three separate `Map`s pretending to be one. Structural failures: **`IntVec3` is not level-qualified** (cell (5,5) exists on all three maps) · **`Thing.mapIndexOrState` is one `sbyte`** so `thing.Map == pawn.Map` is false across levels — a comparison used everywhere in vanilla *and every other mod*, so compat never converges · **`ABVirtualPosition` lies** (`FieldRef`-mutates `positionInt`/`mapIndexOrState`, 43 sites/16 files, re-entrancy held off by a global bool) · **decision ≠ execution** (probes discarded then re-resolved after arrival ⇒ ping-pong, compensated by **289 cooldown/budget/memo/throttle refs across 34 files**) · **reachability + reservations stop at the map edge** ⇒ `StairRouter`/`StairIslands`/`CrossLevelDemand` hand-reimplement region reachability and the reservation manager · `DrawPosOffsetPatcher` exists *solely* because the level below is a different Map.

## The V2 model
One `Map`, `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`, `Slot = bandHeight + Gutter(2)`. Bands stack along **+z** so each is a CONTIGUOUS `CellIndices` range (row-major `z*sizeX+x`). `band = surfaceBand + level`. A 2-row impassable open-air **gutter** guarantees no region/room/temperature zone/section mesh spans a seam implicitly.

| Mechanism | How |
|---|---|
| Connectivity | Two `RegionType.Portal` regions sharing ONE synthetic `RegionLink`. **PROVEN** |
| Rooms & temperature | `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom` + `AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict` ⇒ conducts connectivity, keeps rooms/temp/vacuum separate |
| Movement | `Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath` prefix segments; `PatherArrived` prefix teleports + re-dispatches. ONE interception covers every job/pawn/faction/third-party JobDriver |
| Reservations | Single `reservationManager` ⇒ double-claims impossible |
| Band isolation | Free — `MapDrawer.DrawMapMesh` only draws sections overlapping the ViewRect |

### Hard 1.6 constraint (verified)
**The pathfinder is jobified** (`PathFinderJob`: `IJob` over `NativeArray` + `NativePriorityQueue`; `PathGridJob`: `IJobParallelFor`). A* neighbour expansion is NOT patchable — all custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`. `PathRequest.ValidateInt` gates on `pawn.CanReach`, so reachability and path production must widen together or you get silent `PawnPath.NotFound` loops. 1.6 removed the non-adjacent-cell assert in `SetupMoveIntoNextCell`, so a wormhole step is tolerated.

## Files (`Source/V2/`)
`ABBandMap.cs` (persisted layout; `BandOf` = one integer divide; `Translate` keeps the column aligned 1:1) · `ABBands.cs` (allocation-free CWT-cached facade) · **`ABWormhole.cs`** (synthetic `RegionLink` + mandatory re-arm postfix on `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`) · `ABWormholePather.cs` · `ABBandedGeneration.cs` (size inflation + carve + start-spot fix) · **`ABSkyBandGen.cs`** (mountain generation) · **`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.cs`** (see-below + dirty mirror) · `Building_ABStairs2.cs` · `ABBandView.cs` · `ABBandEnv.cs` · `ABBandInput.cs` · `ABV2DefCleanup.cs` · `ABDevTools.V2*.cs` · `Defs/V2/`.

### NEW — see-below (`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`)
Through every `AB_OpenAir` cell, renders the band below. **The V1 version needed `DrawPosOffsetPatcher` — hundreds of DrawPos getters patched on ParallelPreDraw worker threads — purely because the level below was a foreign Map. V2 needs none of it.** Recipe: let the below thing `Print(this)` at its own real position, then **translate the vertices that print just emitted** up one `Slot` (same contained trick V1 used for its below-thing shrink, applied to position). Nothing is lied to. Masking is by construction — only open-air cells print, so rooftops/mountain caps are opaque and can never lose a render-queue contest (V1's hardest-won rendering lesson). Below content is tinted down and shrunk to `belowThingScale`; rock and linked graphics are exempt from shrink or mountains/wall runs tear into a gappy field (V1 run #50). Fogged cells below never reveal. A `MapDrawer.MapMeshDirty` postfix **mirrors dirty flags one band up** (a section only regenerates when its OWN cells dirty, so a wall built on the surface would otherwise never repaint the sky view); terminates naturally at 3 bands, with an explicit re-entrancy latch.

### NEW — mountain sky (`ABSkyBandGen`)
Ports V1's `GenStep_ABSkyTerrain` classification onto a band rect. `solid` = mineable edifice or thick natural roof **in the band below** (one subtraction, no cross-map lookup or sync mirror). 8-way BFS edge distance, then one low-frequency **meadow Perlin** decides rock vs open: open ⇒ `Plateau` (walkable mountain top) except the outermost ring which stays `Ledge` (or the rock face below stops rendering — V1 run #43); rock ⇒ `Ledge` within a wandering terrace width, `Wall` behind. Terrain: ledge = mountain-top lip · wall = mineable rock under `RoofRockThick`, **deep interior only** fogged (fogging faces lets the fog edge swallow the ledge — V1 regression) · plateau = stone/gravel/biome-arable soil by noise. Outside the mass: constructed roof below → rooftop; natural roof → mountain cap; nothing → open air. Ore scattered into wall cells. **Not ported:** outcrop mounts, hidden-valley breaching (additive polish).

### V1 interlock
V1 goes inert on a banded map by itself (its machinery keys off `upperMap`/`lowerMap`, which stay null). Explicit: `LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate` refuses V1 levels on a banded map; `ABV2DefCleanup` strips V1's 9 vertical-link buildings from the architect menu.

## BUGS FOUND + FIXED IN TESTING (runs #4–#7)
1. **`menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef (1.6)** → self-closing `<designationCategory />` idiom (as Anomaly/Odyssey terrain defs use).
2. **Steam geysers are `destroyable=false`** — `Destroy()` logs an error and the thing SURVIVES, so band fill spawned rock on top of it. Carve now `DeSpawn`s non-destroyables.
3. **No colonists spawned** — `TryFindStartCell` required `!c.Fogged`, but `GenStep_Fog` has fogged the whole map by postfix time ⇒ every cell rejected ⇒ colony dumped on the band centre (usually rock/water). Fog test removed; now translates vanilla's own start spot into the surface band and requires a clear 5×5 apron.
4. **Both V1 and V2 stairs buildable** — V1's have finished art and near-identical labels, so the obvious click was V1's; it correctly hit the interlock and logged "could not resolve a target level map". Interlock right, dead button wrong → `ABV2DefCleanup`.
5. **Sky was a black screen with one lit patch** — carve blanket-fogged ALL non-surface bands. Fog policy is directional: below = rock (fogged, revealed by mining); above = sky (visible).
6. **Sky was a flat void** — `FillSky` just flooded open air → replaced by `ABSkyBandGen`.
7. **`GenRadial` overflow** — radius ≥ `MaxRadialPatternRadius` (~79.8) logs "Not enough squares…" and clamps. Log noise only; capped at 70.
8. **Neighbouring band visible at screen edge** — clamped only `rootPos` (view CENTRE); the camera is orthographic so visible half-height IS `RootSize`. Centre now stays `RootSize` from each edge and zoom is capped at half the band height.

## NOT YET BUILT (priority order)
1. **Stage 4 transplant** — generate a normal map at full vanilla fidelity, move it into band 1. Fixes the **coastline/river/road limitation** (surface band is a slice of a 3×-tall generated map, so map-edge-anchored features can land in a carved band and be lost — **use inland tiles until then**); also the save-migration path and the true-lazy trigger.
2. **V1 deletion** (Stage 2 proper) — now justified by run #7.
3. **Dynamic below-things** — pawns/items below use realtime drawing, not the map mesh, so they don't yet appear through open air (buildings and terrain do).
4. Sky richness (outcrops, hidden valleys) · remaining per-band biome consumers (wild animals, ambient sound, disease MTB, Odyssey `inVacuum`) · real stair art (currently placeholder vanilla doors).

### Per-band biomes (V2's one genuine regression)
`Map.Biome => TileInfo.PrimaryBiome` is one get-only biome per Map; V1 got per-level biomes free via `PocketMapProperties.biome`. V2 resolves explicitly via `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf(map, cell)` — cheap where biome is asked WITH a cell (plants, terrain, fertility: done). **Regression:** third-party biome-aware mods read `map.Biome` and see the surface biome everywhere ⇒ need bridges. **Gets better:** "basement has no weather/plants" is now the ROOF GRID doing vanilla's normal indoor handling, not a fake biome — which is why `LevelClimate`/`ClimateSync` have no V2 counterpart. **REJECTED:** a contextual `Map.Biome` override behind an ambient cell latch — the exact lying-to-vanilla pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

## LOCKED DECISIONS (user)
1. Save break ACCEPTED. 2. Banding LAZY (currently lazy-*reveal*; true lazy needs transplant) — swappable policy. 3. "Levels", not columns: one map, three layers. 4. Stairs are a `Building_Door` subclass. 5. Perf ceiling accepted; About description must **warn that extra floors on large maps cost performance**.

## PROCESS LESSON
Stages 1–4 were built before Stage 0 was validated (user directive: "build it all, test at the end"). Result: **three full runs spent debugging scenery** while the load-bearing hypothesis stayed untested; the thesis test took ~5 minutes once reached. Validate the gate first.

---

# V1 (SHIPPED, superseded)
Workshop `3767572810`. ~130 Harmony patches, 165 files / ~42.5k LOC, levels as pocket maps. Frozen on `master`.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **V2 banding happens at generation ⇒ testing needs a NEW colony** (quicktest qualifies). Map gen is ~3× slower on a banded map — expected, not a hang. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.**

## Status
2026-07-26: V2 proven in-game (run #7). See-below rendering + real mountain sky generation now built (green, untested). Next test should check: sky shows a real mountain (ledge/plateau/wall), open air shows the surface below through it, no band bleed at screen edges, and cross-band hauling still works.
